provenance: Official dolthub/dolt GitHub raw files fetched through GitHub connector; no runtime observation
observations: dbfactory/grpc.go: gRPC dial options and HTTPFetcher are separate dependencies, both passed to remote chunk store
env/grpc_dial_provider.go: builtin helper adds interceptors and wraps HTTPFetcher
credential_helper.go: Authorization is reserved and rejected; helper cannot directly supply that standard bearer header
credential_helper.go: origin-scoped helper wraps initial HTTP request; default underlying http.Client owns redirect behavior
remotesrv/grpc.go: object URLs are sealed; HttpHost/authority and x-forwarded-proto determine advertised origin
chunkstore.proto:12 RPC methods, streaming messages carry repo identity independently; repo_token is opaque
remotesrv/grpc.go: V1 stream can switch repo path between messages; each selector needs authorization before foreign transfer
chunk_store.go: object upload uses PUT with Content-MD5; download uses ranged and whole-table-file paths plus URL refresh
inferences: gRPC credential success alone cannot establish authenticated object transfer
Standard bearer injection and redirect containment need native binding evidence; stock helper is not accepted as proof
Gateway must bind every repository selector and object request to authenticated project; authority/forwarded headers cannot define an untrusted redirect destination
